coverage.note: 核验 Federal Reserve 的货币政策日程（10 月 7 日 FOMC minutes）与 CME Compute Futures 产品页及正式上市资料（10 月 5 日、GPU1/GPU2、730 GPU-hours、USD 7.30 tick）。事件时间、合约字段和条件仅取公开英文一手页。
保留 AP 对 upcoming FOMC minutes 的独立周度确认，以及 Reuters 对 CME/Silicon Data 10 月 5 日计划上市的独立报道。它们不替代一手日程或产品规格。
核验公开 Reddit、ForexFactory 10 月 5 日日历与 BabyPips 新闻/论坛索引。可见材料为日历发现、方向性市场叙事、一般风险讨论或 Compute futures 的产品发现；没有保留可归属、当期且可由现有两站准确承接的非方向性计算请求。
公开可验证索引未出现可保留的当期非方向性计算需求；Quora 索引受 robots 限制。没有使用登录、墙后、截图或不可验证材料。

sources.freshness_role: official page lists FOMC Minutes on October 7 for the September 15-16 meeting
independent report identifies the October 7 FOMC minutes as a coming-week event
public weekly calendar is used only for event discoverability, not facts or direction
discussion asks generally about risk mechanics and position sizing, not an attributable FOMC-minute calculation request

decision.reopen_trigger: A public attributable non-directional calculation question tied specifically to the October 7 minutes plus at least one additional fact, search, example or materially distinct-window delta. Any qualified work must refresh the existing FOMC article rather than create another generic event-risk shape.
decision.rationale: The official calendar and independent coverage sustain factual recency, but the retained audience material has no event-specific non-directional calculation journey. Moving closer to the event is one refresh signal, not a reason to reproduce an existing fixed-risk explanation.

sources.freshness_role: official page identifies October 5 2026 launch context, GPU1/GPU2, 730 GPU-hours per contract and USD 7.30 value per tick
independently reports the planned October 5 launch, which is within the upcoming-seven-day event window
public discussion shows product discovery and broker-access uncertainty, but no current attributable calculator request

decision.reopen_trigger: A versioned existing-site Compute-futures workflow, or a public attributable non-directional exposure request that the existing site can accurately answer after official multiplier, tick, margin, commission, settlement and broker-access terms are all checked.
decision.rationale: The CME page adds a verifiable contract unit and USD 7.30 tick value, but neither PipGauge nor PositionMath has a verified Compute futures contract workflow. A generic CFD, equity or P&L form cannot be presented as an accurate substitute without accepting all relevant contract and broker conditions. No traffic playbook or feature-gap claim is created.
